title: EMGT 4320 Exercise Design and Evaluation, Marlowe State University
summary: A university emergency management course run as an exercise lab: syllabus, role rubrics, a rotation plan and the campus flood annex and notification SOP, with an exercise generated for the week-11 session in which student teams in six seats (incident commander, communications, campus police, student affairs, facilities and a student evaluator) respond to a flash flood that closes the lower campus and forces a residence hall evacuation.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Marlowe State University, the town of Marlowe, the course, its people, offices, media and sites are simulated; Athens County, Ohio and the public agencies are real. No student records are included. The public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/emgt-course/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Ninety Minutes
scenarios.summary: On a wet spring morning Sugar Camp Run rises 1.5 feet an hour through the Marlowe State campus; the students must close Dairy Lane, order Riverside Hall evacuated before its basement floods, open Kessler Fieldhouse as a shelter and keep every message consistent while rumors spread.
